bio: Hi! My name is Tieri and I'm a First-Year from Utah planning on concentrating in Psychology with a secondary in Sociology. I participate in the PBHA's BRYE 1-2-1 service program, serve on the First-Year Social Committee, and am a junior staffer for Harvard Model Congress. In my spare time you may find me thrifting, taking film photos, baking guava cake, or painting.
